contract_metadata.description: Frozen scientific comparison contract for adaptive Mode-II production runs using censoring-corrected H0/H1/H2 evidence

uniform_reference_roles.H1: Minimum supported uniform comparison mesh for elastic stiffness (45.9035 kN/mm), pre-peak RF-U response, damage initiation (7.75 um), and common-window global response (0 <= u1 <= 0.009250 mm)
uniform_reference_roles.H2: Fine uniform spatial-resolution diagnostic (N_phys = 33852, h/l0 = 0.5) for H1/H2 refinement sensitivity, matched-state crack geometry, and h/l0 = 0.5 resolution evidence
negative_rules: Do NOT call H2 a completed post-peak reference.
Do NOT call H1 a fully converged fracture reference.

crack_path_classification.scientific_interpretation: H1 is not accepted as a converged crack-path reference. Spatial fracture geometry remains mesh-sensitive at the tested matched state (0.005443 mm > 0.00375 mm) even though global RF-U response exhibits high convergence.

censored_peak_rule.rule: For adaptive comparisons, prohibit using 361.66 N (H1) and 354.08 N (H2) as demonstrated global peak forces. Any future comparison script must distinguish maximum_observed_RF from global_peak_RF.

DOMAIN_A.name: COMMON_PREPEAK_UNIFORM_DOMAIN
applicable_evaluations: RF-U normalized L2 error versus H1
Initial elastic shear stiffness regression (0 < u1 <= 2 um)
Matched-state phase field metrics (d_max at 9.25 um)
Matched-state crack geometry (Hausdorff vs H1 and H2 at 9.25 um)

DOMAIN_B.name: POST_0p009250_ADAPTIVE_DOMAIN
applicable_evaluations: Internal adaptive convergence between MM and PK5
DOMAIN_B.prohibition: No completed uniform H1/H2 reference exists in Domain B. Post-0.009250 mm conclusions must NOT compare against fabricated or extrapolated H1/H2 curves.

MM.classification_label: Spatial error indicator localization alternative (MINIMUM_MAXIMUM sizing method)
MM.expected_role: Stronger adaptive localization / lower global computational cost

physical_formulation_parity.user_element_type: Mixed 4-node/3-node UEL with 18 SDVs (SDV14=d, SDV15=broken, SDV16=psi_e)

adaptive_candidate_roles.selection_policy: Do not select the winner before fracture results.

domain_A_metrics: Initial elastic shear stiffness K0 (Origin OLS on 0 < u1 <= 2 um)
RF1 vs U1 normalized L2 error versus H1 (<= 2.0% gate)
RF1 vs U1 curve-area (work) difference versus H1
Displacement at damage initiation threshold u1(d >= 0.5)
Displacement at fully broken threshold u1(d >= 0.9)
Maximum phase field damage d_max at matched displacement u1 = 0.009250 mm
Matched-state crack path Hausdorff distance versus H1 and H2 at u1 = 0.009250 mm
full_trajectory_adaptive_metrics: Maximum observed force versus demonstrated global peak force classification
Complete RF1 vs U1 response curve
Fracture / dissipated energy balance where extractable
Total walltime, CPU time, peak memory, and element count scaling

comparator_assignments.H1: Global-response comparator (pre-peak force, damage initiation, stiffness)
comparator_assignments.H2: Fine-mesh spatial sensitivity comparator at matched state (u1 = 0.009250 mm)
comparator_assignments.MM_vs_PK5: Adaptive spatial convergence evidence across refinement strategies

adaptive_acceptance_logic.acceptance_criteria: A final adaptive candidate is accepted if it matches H1 pre-peak global response within 2%, respects damage initiation parity at 7.75 um, demonstrates crack-corridor refinement consistent with H2, maintains stable energy balance, and achieves substantial computational cost reduction over uniform H2.

verified_requested_outputs: S, E, EVOL (stresses, strains, element volume)
Energy output: ALLAE, ALLCD, ALLIE, ALLKE, ALLPD, ALLSE, ALLWK, ETOTAL
output_sufficiency_audit.notes: Existing dry-run packages contain full output definitions. Multi-step fracture production execution packages will inherit these complete output definitions.
